title: DeepReach | The Power of Dynamic Ads for Local Advertising

facts.fact: Dynamic Advertising is also referred to as Dynamic Creative Optimisation (DCO).
facts.quote: Dynamic Advertising, also referred to as Dynamic Creative Optimisation (DCO)

facts.fact: A Dynamic Search Ad appears on search engines and is based on website content rather than specific keywords.
facts.quote: One type of Dynamic Ad is the Dynamic Search Ad, which appears on search engines and is based on website content rather than specific keywords.

facts.fact: The page states that Dynamic Search Ads require no keyword mapping, bid setup, or per-ad text creation.
facts.quote: there is no need to map keywords, set up bids, or create ad text for each ad

facts.fact: The page states that formats used for Dynamic Ads are the same as the standard IAB formats.
facts.quote: The formats used for Dynamic Ads are the same as the standard IAB formats.

facts.fact: The page defines an interstitial ad as one that displays on the entire screen of a device before redirecting the user to the website or application.
facts.quote: the interstitial is an advertisement that displays on the entire screen of a device before redirecting the user to the website or application.

facts.fact: The page states that two things can be customised from a feed: texts and images.
facts.quote: there are two things that can be customised from a feed.

facts.fact: The page states that ad creatives can differ by location in elements such as captions, visuals, and prices.
facts.quote: Ad creatives can differ depending on the location, including elements such as captions, visuals, and prices.

facts.fact: The page lists geographical data, weather data, and product feeds among the data sources used to customise Dynamic Ads, which may come from platforms such as DeepReach or from agency or direct advertiser feeds.
facts.quote: We are talking about geographical data, weather data, product feeds, and more.

facts.fact: The page states that the image variable can be created via HTML5 or with static images using image generation tools.
facts.quote: Its creation can be done via HTML5 or with static images using image generation tools.

facts.fact: The page states that remarketing through Dynamic Ads uses user-based data and CRM cookies with third-party ad networks.
facts.quote: This is done by leveraging user-based data and CRM cookies with 3rd party ad networks.

facts.fact: The page states that feed variables can incorporate platform-specific call-to-action buttons such as "Learn More" or "Shop Now".
facts.quote: incorporate platform-specific call-to-action buttons, such as "Learn More" or "Shop Now,"
